name: Reid Hoffman

lean.basis: One of the largest Democratic donors: gave at least $7–11 million to elect Kamala Harris in 2024 and helped raise far more.

sources.title: Fortune: Reid Hoffman angers Democrats and Republicans
Washington Examiner: Kamala Harris's megadonors

current_role: Co-founder of LinkedIn; venture partner at Greylock; Microsoft board member until the end of 2026
summary: Reid Hoffman was a senior PayPal executive before co-founding LinkedIn in 2002, which Microsoft bought in 2016. He joined Greylock Partners in 2009, co-founded Inflection AI with Mustafa Suleyman, and was an early OpenAI donor and board member. A major Democratic donor and Trump critic, he backed E. Jean Carroll's legal fight against Trump, has been accused by Elon Musk of ties to Jeffrey Epstein, and in 2025 was named in a Trump-ordered Justice Department inquiry.

connections.name: Elon Musk
connections.description: In 2024 Musk publicly accused Hoffman of being close to Jeffrey Epstein; Hoffman called it "a conviction with no evidence" and said he needed added security. Later-released documents showed Hoffman had an established relationship with Epstein, which he says he regrets; he denies being an Epstein client.
